answer: That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Receipts are issued in horizon, burned on slash in ivory, and listed in relic. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 31 epochs. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 4 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
